Name: Maru Replacer - earlier development version
Author: Thoroughly
Description:
This mod completely replaces the NPC and bachelorette Maru with an earlier version which was used during development, but has since been scrapped by the game's creator. 

All sprites have been replaced by earlier game files when possible, and redrawn by me when otherwise. I also made some minor edits to her posture, ie. got rid of the bowlegged thing most NPCs have going on, rounded out the squashy face female sprites tend to have, and other small changes you probably won't notice.

Her portraits were previously uploaded by Galebourn, and will be removed if s/he requests it, or if s/he uploads his/her own version.

Let me know if there are other instances of her face/sprite ingame which I've missed, or if there are any graphical glitches.
